paite: Na lak uah kingaihna nin a-om chih thu athang vengvung hi. Huchibang kingaihna nin Zentelte lak a leng om ngei lou, na lak ua mi khat in amah pa zi akitenpih hi.
heading: Numei Pasal Thangtatna

paite: Huai thilhihpa na lak ua kipan delhkhiak ding a lungngaih nak sang in na kisaktheihpih zaw uhi.
Kei mahmah pumpi in ka pang kei na a, kha in noute lak ah ka om a, thil huchi tel hihpa tu in leng Toupa Jesu min in na lak ua pang bang a kingaihtuah in thupukna ka bawlta hi.
I Toupa Jesu Khrist min a na kikhop chiang un, noute lak ah kha in ka om a, Toupa Jesu Khrist thilhihtheihna leng a-om hi.
Mi huchibang zaw Toupa ni chiang a akha hotdam a a-omtheihna ding in asa hihmang ding in Setan kiang ah pekhia un.
Na kisaktheihna uh hoih lou ahi. Silngou tawmchik in tanghou beu apum in azelsuak chih na thei kei ua hia?
Silngou pang lou na hih mah bang un tanghou beu thak na hong hihtheihna ding un silngou lui pen paikhe siang un. I Paikan Ankuangluina ding Khrist latkhiak in a-omta hi.
Huaiziak in ankuanglui ni, silngou lui a ankuang lui lou in, nunsia leh gitlouhna silngou a leng ankuang lui sam lou in, takna leh thutak tanghou silngou soh louh in ankuang i lui zaw ding uh.
Ka laikhak ah kingaihhatte kithuahpih lou ding in na kiang uah ka gelh hi.
Hiai khovel a kingaihhatte hiam, huaiham leh lepgute hiam, milim bete hiam kithuahpih het louh ding chi ka hi kei a; huchibang hileh khovel a kipan na paikhiak uh kul ding ahi.

Tu'n bel kuapeuh unau min po ngal in, kingaihhatmi hiam, mihuaiham hiam, milim bemi hiam, mihuaiham hiam, milim bemi hiam, hanhatmi hiam, zukham hatmi hiam, lepgumi hiam hileh, kithuahpih lou ding in na kiang uah ka gelh ahi; mi huchibang kiang ah nek leng ne kei un.
Polam mite tung a vaihawm ding ke'n bang ahia ka awlmoh ding om? Nou sung a mite hilou hia na ngaihtuah ding uh?
Polam a mite tung a Pathian in vaihawm hilou hia? “Huai migiloupa na lak ua kipan koihkhia un."
